eligibility_reason: Original estimation and empirical stability findings are valid independent reproduction targets. Source summary arithmetic and several empirical interfaces are executable, but full original scientific identities, source-native complete outputs, numerical criteria and independent execution verification remain unresolved; eligibility is not inherited from improvement.

source_paper.title: iSTTC: A robust method for accurate estimation of intrinsic neural timescales from single-unit recordings

evidence.supports: Synthetic generator parameters and full data grid; Allen cohort/QC; estimation recipe; Eq.21 and empirical reference definition. Eq.21 was visually inspected on PDF page26.
Author reproduction route for 10-minute continuous and 40 one-second trial records; four-estimator comparison and padded-trial treatment.
Pinned implementation parameterizes the exponential directly by tau; publication Methods describes decay rate b and propagated tau uncertainty. Release parity requires verification.
Finite synthetic programme, current-source-only baseline, prospective windows, QC .01 versus .1 discrepancy, and unresolved empirical/native parity.
Original synthetic continuous/trial accuracy, fit quality, parameter interactions, duration/trial-count/bin-size sensitivity, resampling stability, computational cost and aABC comparison.

Original 5775-unit/26-mouse/eight-area cohort; area hierarchy and 50 trial resamples; single-unit contrasts, pseudo-reference stability, sensitivity and inclusion companions. Pseudo-REE is not biological truth error.

evidence.supports: Source absolute percentage REE, tau*50ms, lag-unit CI widths, all-column nonmissing and R2>=0 paired masks, main-panel Lv, coordinate-local sensitivity masks, iteration0, 60/150/300/450/600s and40/60/80/100trials.19 distinct fits per unit support five summary tables, not the complete figure panel.

evidence.locator: Original four-method empirical reduction; companion duration and trial-count notebooks, r_scripts/mice_taus_units_4methods.R and mice_trial_methods_fr_lv.R
evidence.supports: Original empirical source formulas and covariates; historical reference, missingness, fitter and identity ambiguities remain material.

Coordinator-designated final integrated SOURCE d3a4d4ed420bbab19d253da5b44eefca1d73eb00; exact locally inspected component bytes are pinned externally, with no unperformed Git equivalence claim. Runnable source interfaces and generated software controls only. No complete original-finding reproduction, AI attempt or improvement is established.

target.description: Estimate single-unit autocorrelation decay time constants from the same continuous and epoched spike observations. Synthetic Hawkes target is tau_ACF=tau_kernel/(1−alpha); empirical analysis estimates timescales and stability, not known biological truth.

dataset.description: Paper Table3 synthetic Hawkes parameter dataset and its duration/trial variants, plus Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels Functional Connectivity spontaneous activity. Use the original releases and manifestations; new simulations or new window draws are extensions.

cohort.description: Synthetic base comprises 100000 independent parameter sets with f 0.01–10Hz, alpha .1–.9 and tau 50–300ms. Empirical paper cohort is 5775 units spanning eight areas with presence ratio≥.9, ISI violations≤.5 and amplitude cutoff≤.01. Local retained loader policy differs on amplitude cutoff; authentic original roster is not reconciled.

split.description: This is an estimator study, not a published train/test learner split. Reuse the exact original 600-second records, 40/60/80/100 one-second trial draws and duration truncations; original trial/window realizations and any tuning exposure are not recovered. A held-out generator partition would be an extension.

inputs.description: Spike times and the condition-specific observation duration/trial structure. The synthetic truth tau, generator parameters and author fitted results are evaluator information; empirical full-duration references must not leak into a trial-only candidate.

preprocessing.description: Methods4.4–4.5 specify 20 lags, 50-ms lag/bin, 25-ms STTC tolerance, 3000-ms trial padding and single-exponential fitting from lag1 (lag2 for area fits), excluding NaN ACFs. Publication b-based fitting/uncertainty and current tau-based source must be reconciled; historical quality masks remain material.

metric.description: Methods4.8 Eq21 displays 100*(tau_est−tau_truth)/tau_truth. Registered policy uses 100*abs(tau_est−tau_ref)/tau_ref and conditional mean/median summaries. Resolve the original figure-producing absolute/signed convention and masks from primary code before assigning a lower-is-better success criterion. Empirical reference is full-duration ACF/iSTTC, so pseudo-REE is stability rather than truth error.

aggregation.description: Retain complete original continuous/trial/duration conditions, success/failed-fit denominators and source condition/model summaries. No favorable successful-fit subset or newly weighted aggregate may replace source figures. Original numerical aggregate baseline and exact masks are not authenticated.

full_panel.description: Retain the original100000 synthetic parameter draws across continuous and trial-based estimation, all original duration/trial-count conditions, source errors and complete failures/quality masks, figure/model/parameter-interaction and stability companions, bin/lag and padding checks, computational-cost analyses and the source-defined10000-unit aABC companion subset. The recovered19-fit-per-unit source summary is an intermediate, not this complete panel. Retain the registered empirical5775 units from26mice and eight areas, original40 one-second windows, per-area hierarchy and50 sampling repetitions, four-method single-unit results, original duration/trial-count and resampling/inclusion companions. Required arrays include REE parameter maps and inclusion curves, quality profiles, resampling convergence, bin/lag and padding outputs, runtime curves, aABC distributions, empirical area hierarchies, unit distributions and duration/trial curves. These remain explicit obligations in source evidence, blockers and the external granular-interface inventory, never scalar placeholders. Exact original manifests, figure reductions and some companion source outputs remain unresolved; this scalar contract is a partial representation, and no smaller available panel substitutes for the full panel.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same source paper and original condition-specific spike times, observation durations and trial structure. Only the paper_data_author_code condition additionally receives the frozen author-code allowlist. Evaluator-only synthetic truths/generator parameters, author fitted results, and empirical full-duration reference fits are excluded from candidate observation views; a trial-only analysis cannot access full-duration observations as an undeclared input. Public source exposure is recorded and does not establish secrecy. Original observation identity and enforcement still require authenticated paired manifests.
